problem: La boule de cristal montre un cercle et un carré : ce sont les réponses des questions 1 (REPETE 4 → carré) et 3 (REPETE 360 → cercle).
visual: A cartoon turtle with a pencil looking into a crystal ball that is filled only with swirling mist and a big question mark; on the table beside it, a short ribbon of blank command blocks with a loop symbol. No finished shape visible anywhere.

problem: Deux élèves qui pensent à une carte d'identité : rien ne montre une bonne et une mauvaise pratique.
visual: Split scene with a vertical divider. Left half, soft green background with a big green check badge: a student standing up and closing a padlock on their screen before leaving. Right half, soft red background with a big red cross badge: a student passing a sticky note with a key drawn on it to a classmate. No text.

problem: Les deux diapositives sont propres : il manque la mauvaise diapositive.
visual: Two slides side by side on easels. Left slide with a green check badge: one short title bar, three bullet dots and one picture, lots of white space. Right slide with a red cross badge: crammed from edge to edge with dense tiny lines of grey squiggles, clashing colours, no picture. No readable text.

problem: Deux pages web identiques : impossible de voir laquelle est fiable.
visual: Two web pages side by side. Left with a green check badge: an official page with a building emblem, a seal ribbon, an author avatar and a small calendar date. Right with a red cross badge: a phone screen showing an anonymous message bubble with a faceless grey avatar, many exclamation and question marks. A student with a magnifying glass between them.

problem: Deux portes vertes identiques : il manque le côté interdit ou risqué.
visual: Two doors. Left: a green open door with a green check above it, an official document, a public-domain picture and an open-source box going through. Right: a red door barred with planks and a red cross above it, a pirate flag and a broken film reel in front of it. Two students choosing.

problem: Trois enveloppes identiques sur le tapis : rien ne distingue une adresse valide d'une adresse invalide.
visual: Three envelopes on a conveyor belt, each with an address bar drawn as coloured blocks. The first has a complete bar with one at-sign symbol in the middle and a green check. The second has a gap (space) in the middle of the bar and a red cross. The third has no at-sign at all and a red cross. No letters.

problem: Aucune pièce jointe suspecte n'est montrée.
visual: An inbox with three attachments clipped by paperclips: a document page and a photo album with a green shield (safe), and a strange gift box with a skull warning sign and a red cross coming from a faceless grey sender (suspicious). A student hesitating, hand raised in a stop gesture toward the gift box.

problem: Un seul cadenas : il manque la comparaison fort / faible.
visual: Two padlocks side by side. Left: a heavy, thick padlock built from many different shaped pieces, with a full green strength bar under it. Right: a thin cracked padlock made of one repeated shape, with a short red strength bar under it. A student comparing them.

problem: Trois avatars identiques : rien ne distingue administrateur, utilisateur standard et invité.
visual: Three user cards side by side. Left: an adult avatar with a gear-and-key badge and a toolbox (administrator). Centre: a student avatar with a personal folder (standard user). Right: a faded, dotted-outline avatar with a visitor badge and an hourglass (guest). No text.

problem: Une élève devant une feuille vide : on ne voit ni cellule, ni ligne, ni colonne, ni plage.
visual: Close-up of a spreadsheet grid: one column band tinted teal, one row band tinted blue, the single cell where they cross framed with a thick border, and a mouse pointer dragging a selection over several cells below. Header strips blank.

problem: Une élève qui regarde un tableur : ni signe =, ni poignée de recopie.
visual: A spreadsheet close-up: a large equals-sign key glowing on a keyboard, an arrow to a selected cell, and a small square fill handle at the corner of that cell being dragged down over three cells by a mouse pointer, motion lines.

problem: Tortue sur une feuille blanche : la rosace de carrés de l'activité n'apparaît pas.
visual: A turtle at the centre of a rosette made of twelve squares rotated around one point, drawn as navy pencil trails, plus two small separate squares and a single square shown at the side as a gallery of drawings.

problem: Drapeaux britannique et italien absents de l'activité, Sénégal absent (l'activité porte sur .ma, .fr, .es, .sn).
visual: A globe with four small flags around it on one side (Morocco, France, Spain, Senegal) and three organisation symbols on the other side (government building, university, association building), students looking at a laptop.
